transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1846 Gretna Green Drive?
Yes, this is 1846 Gretna Green Drive. I’m safe and alone, no water inside, and I can’t leave on my own — but I don’t need help right now.
Thank you for confirming your safety and current situation. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s one person here, and I’m the only one — no one else is at the house or unable to come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know you’re the only one here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just wanted to correct myself — I’m the only person here, and no one needs special help.
Thanks for clarifying — you’re the only person here. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, there’s no water inside the home. Just me here, and I’m fine.
Thank you for letting us know you’re okay. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a high-clearance truck, boat, or any free seats in a vehicle to help neighbors.
Thank you for sharing your current situation. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — just one person here, no water inside yet.
Thanks for confirming your situation. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
